name: agentic-engineering
description: Agentic engineering kit: seven skills (context engineering, harness engineering, skill development, agent development, evals, sandboxing, fewer faster tests), most named by a short block a hook prints at the moment it applies; an agentic-engineer agent that starts with two of them loaded; /new-plugin, which makes your own plugin in a folder you pick; and /new-agent and /new-skill, which write the file into that plugin or the project from the skill's template, or hand your words to Claude with the skill loaded (a Claude Mod: needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1).

setup.summary: seven skills, an agentic-engineer agent, /new-plugin for your own plugin, and /new-agent and /new-skill for building with agents
gives: seven skills Claude loads when one applies — context, harness, skill and agent development, evals, sandboxing, fewer faster tests
an agentic-engineer agent, with two of them loaded
a one-line reminder from a hook at the moment a rule applies
/new-plugin — your own plugin, in a folder you pick: a git repo of your skills and agents, on in every session
/new-agent and /new-skill — a new agent or skill file from the skill's template, into your plugin or the project
